I’ll keep the **Bachelor of Accounting** as our subject.

### Bachelor of Accounting
- **Credential:** Bachelor’s Degree  
- **School:** School of Business + Media  
- **Campus:** Burnaby Campus  
- **Delivery:** In person  
- **Study options:** Full-time day stream or part-time Flexible Learning  
- **Academic requirement:** 60 credits  
- **Maximum completion time:** Seven years  

The program is designed to support progression toward CPA-related studies, but completing the degree does **not itself award CPA designation or licensure**.

### Curriculum
- **Required course:**  
  - **FMGT 8911 — Strategic Performance Management**
- **Technical specialty requirement:** Choose **seven courses** from the approved pool:
  - **ACCG 6310 — Auditing and Assurance**
  - **FMGT 7121 — Advanced Accounting**
  - **FMGT 7210 — Advanced Management Accounting**
  - **FMGT 7310 — Advanced Auditing**
  - **FMGT 7410 — Taxation of Close Corporations**
  - **FMGT 7510 — Advanced Finance**
  - **FMGT 7520 — Business Valuation**
  - **FMGT 7910 — The Business Environment**
  - **FMGT 8121 — Contemporary Issues in Accounting**
  - **FMGT 8610 — Independent Technical Studies Abroad 1**
  - **FMGT 8620 — Independent Technical Studies Abroad 2**
  - **FMGT 8920 — Case Writing Fundamentals**
- **General Education:** 36 credits, including:
  - **LIBS 7001 — Critical Reading and Writing**
  - **LIBS 7002 — Applied Ethics**
  - Additional approved General Education credits in the specified categories
- **Optional work terms** for eligible full-time domestic students:
  - **FMGT 7610 — Workplace Education Workterm 1**
  - **FMGT 7620 — Workplace Education Workterm 2**

The work terms are optional and do not form part of the 60-credit academic requirement.

### Admission information
The stored program requirements include:
- A BCIT Accounting, Finance, or Financial Planning diploma, or an equivalent external diploma assessed individually
- Minimum diploma GPA of **70%**
- English Studies 12 at **67%**, or equivalent
- Subject-sequence average requirements that require departmental confirmation
- A signed departmental pre-entry assessment and any assigned upgrading or bridging

International applicants may apply, but a valid BCIT study permit is required before starting. The optional work-term courses are unavailable to international students.

Program details: https://www.bcit.ca/programs/accounting-bachelor-of-accounting-full-time-part-time-8630bacc/

program.program_overview: The Bachelor of Accounting program offers an academic credential leading to a Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation. Choose between part-time Flexible Learning or full-time day stream options. Apply today to develop essential technical, communication, and problem-solving skills for success in the accounting field. Delivery: in person. See details . If you have completed a BCIT Accounting , Finance , or Financial Planning diploma, you can earn your Bachelor of Accounting (BAcc) at BCIT. This degree will provide you with an academic credential leading to a CPA (Chartered Professional Accountant ) designation, a MPAcc (Master of Professional Accounting) , or an MBA program. Students completing this program will acquire the key technical, interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills demanded by employers. The BCIT model: fast, flexible and effective BCIT’s Bachelor of Accounting is offered as: Flexible Learning: The flexible part-time program allows you to maintain your career and study at the same time. You can register course by course, and apply for admission to the program any time. Or Full-Time Day Stream: This program is offered on a full-time basis for those students who want to accelerate their completion of the program. The program starts every September and January. International study BCIT offers a number of international study opportunities that helps students gain a global perspective of the economy, culture, government, and everyday life of the country they study in. You could participate in a summer field school or complete an international degree. Learn more about studying abroad . Next up Entrance Requirements

### Bachelor of Accounting — Short Overview

The Bachelor of Accounting is an in-person bachelor’s degree offered at BCIT’s Burnaby Campus through full-time day studies or part-time Flexible Learning. It is designed for students with an Accounting, Finance, or Financial Planning diploma and supports preparation for further CPA-related studies.

The program requires **60 credits**, including:

- **FMGT 8911 — Strategic Performance Management**
- **Seven courses chosen from the approved technical specialty pool**
- **36 credits of General Education**, including **LIBS 7001 — Critical Reading and Writing** and **LIBS 7002 — Applied Ethics**

Optional work terms include **FMGT 7610 — Workplace Education Workterm 1** and **FMGT 7620 — Workplace Education Workterm 2**. The maximum completion time is seven years.
